2607.05891.title: Few-Medoids: An Embarrassingly Simple Coreset Selection Method for Few-Shot Knowledge Distillation
2607.05891.paper_summary: Coreset selection aims to identify a small and highly representative subset of a massive dataset for efficient model training. The problem remains challenging even in the few-shot knowledge distillation (KD) setup, where a full-scale pre-trained teacher informs the student network. Typical sample selection strategies often struggle to surpass the random selection baseline. In this paper, we showcase few-medoids, an embarrassingly simple coreset selection strategy that chooses the samples closest to the centroid (average image) of each class. We present extensive KD experiments on four datasets, covering a wide range of image classification problems, and three teacher-student model pairs, comprising both convolutional and transformer networks. Although the proposed method is embarrassingly simple, our empirical results indicate that few-medoids is able to consistently surpass the random selection baseline, as well as the other coreset selection strategies. We therefore consider that few-medoids can be used as a drop-in replacement for commonly-used baselines (e.g. herding or k-center Greedy), in future research on coreset selection. To reproduce the reported results, we publicly release our code at https://github.com/CemilAndreiDilmac/Few-Shot-KD-Coreset.
2607.05891.paper_summary_zh: Coreset 選擇的目的是從龐大的數據集中識別出一個小而高度具代表性的子集，以便進行高效的模型訓練。即使在少量樣本知識蒸餾 (KD) 設置中，這個問題仍然具有挑戰性，在這種設置中，全規模的預訓練教師會指導學生網絡。典型的樣本選擇策略往往難以超越隨機選擇的基準。本文展示了 few-medoids，一種極其簡單的 coreset 選擇策略，該策略選擇最接近每個類別的質心（平均圖像）的樣本。我們在四個數據集上進行了廣泛的 KD 實驗，涵蓋了廣泛的圖像分類問題，以及三對教師-學生模型，包括卷積網絡和Transformer網絡。儘管所提出的方法極其簡單，但我們的實證結果表明，few-medoids 能夠穩定地超越隨機選擇的基準，以及其他 coreset 選擇策略。因此，我們認為 few-medoids 可以作為未來 coreset 選擇研究中常用基準（例如 herd 或 k-center Greedy）的替代方案。為了重現報告的結果，我們在 https://github.com/CemilAndreiDilmac/Few-Shot-KD-Coreset 上公開釋出了我們的代碼。
